scope: Independent read-only integration review of downsample arithmetic/layout/count/state composition. No hardware, whole timeline, full project, or live Cubase conformance claim.
result: No actionable composition or memory-safety defect found within the declared bounded source-event route.
checked: Source/output are finite integral8k..192k, unequal; equal-rate source uses existing route. Integer rates in this range are exactlyFloat32-representable.
Downstream count uses count_blocks from fresh state with8192limit and ABOVE. Processing calls the same next_block helper, preserving the counted partition sequence including8191+2 instead of8192+1.

Single arena places output directly after all copied input samples and provides max(2,count*2) capacity. Explicit process logical output capacitycount matches exact prediction and actual pointer ordering satisfies ABOVE.
Immutable source snapshot is copied before processing. Per-call state is a Swift value and assigned only after C process success/produced-count match.
Zero-output calls advance input/state and continue, so they are not mistaken forEOF. No padding/flush extends the retained exact count.
OutputFloat32 gain is applied after conversion. Frame counts and duration use actual aggregate count, retaining small-ratio partition effects.
Seek resets state and prerolls the same partitions; suffix buffering preserves the exact remaining output from the crossing block. Seek-to-end produces no frames and skips expensive preroll.
Positive bounded rates permit nonnil stereoFloat32 format. Arrays and integer arithmetic are bounded by16m source/output frames and8192-source block policy.
limits: This is a source review, not another independent mathematical oracle or test execution.
Source array count is validated atconstruction but sample-domain validation is deferred to each C block; nonfinite or nonzero subnormal inputs fail during preparation/preroll/playback.

If separate post-conversion gain fails, cursor converter/input position has already advanced. Caller must stop/discard that cursor; retrying it would not replay the failed block. The method throws an explicit playback-stopped error and does not promise cursor transactionality.
The existing transfer/ring, AVAudioEngine device routing, cancellation and UI lifecycle are outside this narrow review.
ABOVE allocation order and block partitioning are explicit application policies, not inferred Cubase-host behavior.
